NUMBER:
4276
 
AUTHOR:
Oliver Goldsmith
 (1730?–1774)
 
QUOTATION:
Where wealth and freedom reign contentment fails,
And honour sinks where commerce long prevails.
 
ATTRIBUTION:
The Traveller. Line 91.
